sloka: केचिदुच्छ्रितलाङ्गूलाः प्रहृष्टाः कपिकुञ्जराः ।अञ्चिता यतदीर्घाणि लांगूलानि प्रविव्यधुः ।। 5.57.42 ।।।।
transliteration: keciducchritalāṅgūlāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapikuñjarāḥ ।añcitā yatadīrghāṇi lāṁgūlāni pravivyadhuḥ ।। 5.57.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Some elephantlike vanaras who were excited and felt overjoyed lifted their long and beautiful tails and hit them on the ground.
